ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; pixel distribution is heavily skewed toward low-intensity (black) values across over 95% of the visible ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 35 degrees; the notch depth is roughly 10% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across both lobes. The right lobe trailing edge displays 6-8 distinct peaks with pixel-amplitudes reaching approximately 15-20 pixels in height relative to local baseline. Left lobe displays similar jagged irregularity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory from the median notch extending upward toward the distal tips (apices).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity (off-white/beige) circular pixel groups (barnacle colonies) located at both the left and right distal tips (apices).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A secondary deep indentation or 'chunk' is missing from the trailing edge immediately adjacent (left-side) to the true median notch, creating a distinctive irregular profile. Evidence of significant tissue loss/irregularity on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'double notch' visual profile created by the proximity of an acquired injury to the biological median notch.
